name: visual_source_bridges

import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,base64
L=Path.cwd()
for name,page in [('parking',20),('parking',22),('evidence',4)]:
 r=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f',str(page),'-l',str(page),'-singlefile','-scale-to','1000','-jpeg','-jpegopt','quality=45',f'sources/{name}.pdf'],capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
 b=base64.b64encode(r.stdout).decode();z=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/python3','-I','-B',str(L/'write_lane.py'),f'sources/{name}-page{page}.jpg','--base64'],input=b,text=True,capture_output=True);assert z.returncode==0
 print('IMAGE64:'+b)
